note: Well 42-003-01689 has been producing zero oil since 2019-04. The last 12-month holdout window (approx 2021-10 to 2022-09) is entirely zeros, so MAPE cannot be computed. No DCA parameter tuning is possible with this evaluation framework. The well had multiple production phases: initial production ~1141 bbl/mo (2008-03), workover peak ~1833 bbl/mo (2011-08), then steep decline through 2014, sporadic low production 2015-2019, then permanently zero.
